verdict.reason: Every trace line matches the code (User at Admin.java:4, wipe at 25-27, export at 31-33), but whether an OWNER of one tenant can act on another depends on whether roles are tenant-scoped, and the only file here (Admin.java) cannot show that, while the route handler and Repo implementation are absent.
